title: Object shot down over Alaska said to have reassembled itself
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Object shot down over Alaska said to have reassembled itself, about 2023 at Alaska / Canada, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I heard things like it had reassembled itself and been seen flying over Canada.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about an object shot down over Alaska in 2023. He says he heard claims that it had put itself back together and was later seen flying over Canada. If true, it would mean the object was not anything ordinary, but something able to repair itself.
